package_title: Cost structure, MFE/MAE and expected-excursion estimator

config.candle_close_time_derivation: open_time + 5 minutes (the archive has no explicit candle close column)
config.slippage_treatment: Attribution only; slippage is price distortion already inside gross PnL and is never deducted twice.

mfe_mae_summary.limitation: OHLC derived excursion estimates over 5m candles; not tick-level path truth.

provenance.no_lookahead_rule: Every MFE/MAE uses only candles closing inside the observed holding interval and not after as_of; every pre-entry distribution uses only observations matured before the candidate entry.
limitations: Single bounded 24h forward-paper export; not a statistical sample.
Manifest declares BOUNDED_BEST_EFFORT_NOT_REPEATABLE_READ and mutable position snapshots.
Pre-entry expected MFE has an extremely small matured population; INSUFFICIENT_DATA is reported instead of a fabricated estimate.
No prospective shadow history: results are descriptive, never a profitability claim.
